title: All-mean sharpness and non-Hessian-polyconvexity have their own quantifiers
statement: Completed solo producer Theorems A/C: for every finite r>=3/4, the scalar-Hessian QC completion P_(r,1) has optimal quadratic coefficient nu=1 for EVERY symmetric background. This is not a claim of the optimal constant in the original zero-mean discriminant inequality. At M=(0,2,0), P_(r,nu)(p,2,0)-P_(r,nu)(0,2,0)=(nu-1)p^2+c40 p^4, where c40=(r+1)^2(2r+1)^2/[8(r+2)^2]>0. Actual psi=epsilon cos(x) gives gap (nu-1)epsilon^2/2+3c40 epsilon^4/8, negative for nu<1 and sufficiently small epsilon. The producer also proves P_(r,1) is not Hessian-polyconvex. A convex lift in (S,det S) would have a subgradient at the origin and force P(S)>=lambda det S. Its quadratic part p^2-lambda(pw-q^2) must be PSD; the absent w^2 term forces lambda=0. For B(r)=(9r^3+36r^2+40r+12)/[8r(r+1)^2] and q*=1/[2(r+1)^2 B(r)], P(0,q*,0)=-(q*)^3/[2(r+1)^2]<0, contradicting that support. This pointwise support witness is NOT a negative compatible Jensen field. Scalar-Hessian QC/non-polyconvexity does not establish ordinary full 2x2 gradient ROC/QC separation. At r=1, J1=F_(1,4)/8 and earlier acquired global QC already implies the scalar inequality at that parameter; the current claim is a direct parameter-uniform completion, not a priority claim. Final receiver reports added support-coefficient checks; no Capital replay or independent new audit. A later completed source-informed coordinator assessment reads the full proof and reruns BOTH producer-authored checkers against frozen completed inputs:112 parameter-matrix checks and the exact small-r heat obstruction pass. It assesses the continuum finite-r>=3/4 compatible-field theorem,all-background scalar-Hessian QC,all-mean sharp coefficient,non-Hessian-polyconvexity,leading coercivity and actual ordinary-heat method obstruction at their stated scopes. This is substantive internal acceptance from an informed coordinator with prior exposure,not a blind or independently authored audit. It is a NEW receipt distinct from the earlier64-check interim run and does not identify every prior producer-executed byte. No Capital science replay or new correctness investigation was performed.
